subject: Adding back removed sample IDs to a cross

messages.author: 44caf45991669c2d
messages.subject: Adding back removed sample IDs to a cross
parts:
Hi all,

It is well known that the id column from the cross (cross$pheno['id']) would need to be removed for some functions to work. Sometimes, however, for presentation purposes, I would like to put back the ids to the cross for archival purposes, for example before running write.cross.

While I have the copy of the cross that still contains the id column, I'm unsure how to add that back to a cross having the id column removed. Is that just a normal cbind operation (noid.cross$pheno=cbind(cross$pheno["id"],noid.cross$pheno) or similar) or something else?

Thanks for the help!

Cheers,

John MC Ma
Graduate Assistant
Kwitek Lab

Iowa City IA 52242

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Adding back removed sample IDs to a cross
parts:
Yes, that should work.  

I would do:

  noid.cross$pheno <- cbind(id=cross$pheno$id, noid.cross$pheno)

I'm not sure that I would say "it is well known that the id column ... would need to be removed for some functions to work".  I think it's just mqmscanall that is the problem.

karl

messages.subject: Re: Adding back removed sample IDs to a cross
parts:
Well, that's not your fault, really; the main reason that I removed the IDs was the R module 'eqtl' , whose key methods don't support ID columns either.

BTW, a little request here: if it possible to make a find.pheno method for scan* objects? It's difficult enough for me to identify the lodcolumn where the trait of interest is when there're enough many of them.

John

In the short term, I'd suggest using

match("blah", colnames(output))-2
